entities.summary: Isaiah Shaquille Taylor is an American professional basketball player who last played for Dubai Basketball of the ABA League. He has previously played in the National Basketball Association (NBA) for the Houston Rockets and Atlanta Hawks, and three seasons of college basketball for the Texas Longhorns.
